title: Vel Sartha
description: Vel Sartha led the heist squad on Aldhani. Sartha took Cassian Andor as part of the team at the behest of Luthen Rael. After the heist, Sartha visited her cousin, Mon Mothma, who was secretly a leader of the Rebellion. Sartha and Cinta Kaz received orders to kill Andor, but with the riot on Ferrix, they did not complete that objective.
